643-6495-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-6495-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 3.
643-6495-6871-6879.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

671-1957-2530--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
671-1957-2530--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Daxos trigger and when the creature dies, Daxos triggers.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve both Daxos abilities, gaining 2 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

803-3899-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-3899-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

13-7841-8089.description:
Activate Selenia by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

573-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

2021-2060-7061-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

539-3007-3899-4552-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4552-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-7741.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-7741.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

4149-4460-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1017-1912-7426-7628.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1017-1912-7426-7628.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-2092-4549.easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken legendary creature that is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-2092-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping the legendary creature that's paired with Deadeye Navigator, adding {U}.
Activate the legendary creature by paying {U} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, blinking it.
When the legendary creature enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing the legendary creature and Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat.
1409-2092-4549.notes: You can use Agatha of the Vile Cauldron as the legendary creature if desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
413-6972-7325.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station and Mighty Mutanimals trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mighty Mutanimals trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2292-6887-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1169-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1169-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-7193.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Omni-Changeling.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Omni-Changeling by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4677-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-4677-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2060-2908-6930-7057.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

851-3875-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
851-3875-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4593-6705-6752.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Frog enter the battlefield, Haliya triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Frog, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-6705-6752.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Frog.

1874-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5147-6010--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4681-5231-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

997-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

983-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
983-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Temple of the False God and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Temple of the False God and another land.
Activate Temple of the False God and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

1753-2457-2557-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

997-2091-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
997-2091-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

1247-1606-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1606-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

478-2821-3230-3664-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3230-3664-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Coral Atoll.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

190-1165-4053.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Archfiend of the Dross and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
The Archfiend of the Dross tokens enter the battlefield with zero oil counters due to Solemnity.
At the beginning of each oppponent's next upkeep, their Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing them to lose the game.

1420-2034-2178.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2034-2178.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Repeat.

1335-2060-2313-2744.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2060-2313-2744.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers putting two +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

186-2034-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1987-2510-2556-3448.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-2556-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
